name: Southern Natural Gas South System Expansion II Phase 1A loops

values.OtherEnglishNames: SONAT South Sys Expansion II Phase 1A

researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 275: 'SONAT South Sys Expansion II Phase 1A*', Southern Natural Gas Co, Expansion, Completed, MS to AL, FERC docket CP02-01, cost 62 (millions) so 62000000 USD, 24 miles, 97.9 MMcf/d additional capacity, diameters 30 and 36 inches. The EIA completed-date cell reads 1903-11-05, an obvious typo; year in service 2003 is used (EIA's own Year In Service column). Not an existing GEM row: the roster has only P0252 (whole Southern Natural Gas system) and P7855 (South System Expansion 4, proposed). Passes add-threshold: sponsor Southern Natural Gas, MS to AL endpoints, completed (concrete step), 24 mi = about 38.6 km, at least 25 km. Single origin (EIA) for the length, so tier medium; no FERC filing or operator release for Phase 1A specifically found (CP02-01 is the docket for the whole expansion). A 2003 news article from Natural Gas Intelligence says Phase One of South System Expansion II added 67.8 miles of looping, with Phase Two 46.4 miles; this matches EIA's separate rows for Phase 1 (67.8 mi) and Phase 2, and does not mention Phase 1A, so Phase 1A is not shown to be double counted inside Phase 1 but the possibility is flagged for review: if the Phase 1 candidate is also staged, a person should decide whether to combine. Owner spelled per gazetteer exact hit 'Southern Natural Gas'; Parent not filled (owner in 2003 was El Paso, now Kinder Morgan, not sourced here). Start and end locations are not named by EIA, so only states are filled. No route found; route not researched beyond state level. Diameter shown as '30, 36' (EIA lists two sizes).
